label: v164
changes: The calendar now spots appointments that were saved twice and offers to tidy them up. You see exactly what would go before anything is removed, and one copy of each is always kept — the one with the most detail on it.
Anything coming from a calendar you subscribed to is left alone, since removing it would only bring it back on the next refresh.
Small fix: the new "show Teluva in your own calendar" section no longer appears with nothing under it while it is still loading.
